text:
zach: Quick follow-up from the PM postmortem — we still have 4 open items: (1) short-term eviction fix, (2) add nightly regression evals, (3) update runbook + canary checklist, (4) tie historical incidents to the same root cause. Need explicit owners and JIRA links.
rita: I can pick up (3) runbook + canary checklist. Will create a ticket and draft the checklist with rollback steps.
omar: I'll take (1) the eviction/backpressure change and own the PR. Will add perf tests.
li: I can do (2) nightly regression evals and wire a CI job to fail on memory regressions. Also happy to consolidate the log queries for (4).
pm-bot: Jira RW-6123 created by @omar - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-6123
omar: RW-6123: Reduce KV retention + add eviction backpressure hook. Assignee=omar. Target PR: 2026-04-20. AC: under synthetic "prefix-stress" workload, kv_cache_size 95th pct <= baseline +10% for 24h.
rita: RW-6124 created for runbook/canary by @rita - https://jira.redwood.ai/browse/RW-6124
li: I'll create RW-6125 for nightly evals and CI gating. Will include an automated check: fail if 95th pct memory increases >8% for 3 runs.
rita: Proposed RACI (I'll paste into RW-6123/6124/6125): Omar=R, Rita=A (runbook & canary), Li=C (evals + diagnostics), Zach=I (PM). Anyone object?
omar: Sounds good. I'll remain primary for the code and perf tests. Rita, ping me when you have the canary checklist so I can validate the canary steps.
li: For diagnostics I'll attach two grep snippets to RW-6123:
```
# top kv cache entries
zgrep "kv_cache_size" /var/log/*/service.log | awk '{print $1,$4,$7}' | sort -k3 -n | tail -n 40
# incidents with eviction/oom markers
awk '/eviction/ || /oom/ {print $0}' /var/log/incidents.log | sed -n '1,200p'
```
li: I'll also add a short mapping that links incident IDs 2026-02-18 and 2026-03-11 and note the matching signature: rapid kv growth followed by eviction bursts.
zach: Please also include acceptance criteria for RW-6124 canary: 48h stable, zero OOMs, and monitoring alerts show no >2x normal eviction rate.
omar: Adding those ACs to RW-6123 and will include perf regression scripts. Eval prompt I'll use: generate long repeated prefixes up to 1024 tokens and sample kv stats every 10s.
rita: I'll include a rollback checklist in RW-6124 and link dashboards (kv_cache_size graph + eviction rate). Also schedule an infra gating call before canary.
canary-bot: Canary scheduled for rw-dedicated-prod by @rita at 2026-04-22T03:00Z
li: Timeline proposal: PR by 2026-04-20, internal review 2026-04-21, canary 2026-04-22-24, close PM follow-up by 2026-04-29 if ACs met.
omar: ack. If the pre-merge perf tests show regressions we'll delay canary and open RW-6126 for deeper investigation.
zach: Let's meet for a 15m sync Mon 2026-04-21 09:00 UTC to confirm PR state and monitoring readiness. If anyone can't make it call out now.
li: I can make it. I'll attach the initial grep outputs to RW-6123 before the sync.
rita: I'll draft the canary playbook today and link to RW-6124.
pm-bot: Reminder created: PM follow-up RW-6123 sync - 2026-04-21 09:00 UTC
zach: Thanks all — keep updates in the tickets. We'll only post final closure here after canary passes and ACs are met.
